rows.note: Use 火 as the all-purpose noun for combustion, flames, or a deliberately lit fire.

example.english: We lit a fire at the campsite.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 jing4 dei6 sang1 fo2

rows.note: Use 炒 as the all-purpose colloquial verb for dismissing someone from a job.

example.english: Our company decided to fire the employee who was always late.
example.traditional: 我哋公司今日炒咗嗰個成日遲到嘅員工。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 gam1 jat6 caau2 zo2 go2 go3 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3 ge3 jyun4 gung1

rows.note: Use 火警 for an accidental fire or fire emergency at a particular place.

example.english: There’s a fire emergency over at that building—get out quickly!
example.traditional: 大廈嗰邊有火警，快啲走！
example.jyutping: daai6 haa6 go2 bin1 jau5 fo2 ging2 faai3 di1 zau2

rows.note: Use 開火 for firing weapons, especially when opening fire or firing at a target.

example.english: The troops opened fire as soon as the enemy appeared.
example.traditional: 敵人一出現，部隊即刻開火。
example.jyutping: dik6 jan4 jat1 ceot1 jin6 bou6 deoi6 zik1 hak1 hoi1 fo2

rows.note: Use 點著 when causing something such as a building or object to catch fire.

example.english: They carelessly burned things and set the house on fire.
example.traditional: 佢哋亂咁燒嘢，仲點著咗間屋。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 lyun6 gam2 siu1 je5 zung6 dim2 zoek6 zo2 gaan1 uk1

rows.note: Use 熱情 when “fire” means positive passion or creative and intellectual enthusiasm.

example.english: This teacher has real fire for teaching.
example.traditional: 呢位老師對教學好有熱情。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 lou5 si1 deoi3 gaau3 hok6 hou2 jau5 jit6 cing4

rows.note: Use 火氣 when “fire” means anger or a hot temper, rather than passion in general.

example.english: You don’t need to come in with so much fire; let’s talk it out.
example.traditional: 你唔使咁大火氣，有嘢慢慢講。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 daai6 fo2 hei3 jau5 je5 maan6 maan6 gong2

rows.note: Use 挑起 when inflaming or provoking anger, passion, or another strong feeling.

example.english: What they said really did fire up my anger.
example.traditional: 佢句說話真係挑起我把火。
example.jyutping: keoi5 geoi3 syut3 waa6 zan1 hai6 tiu1 hei2 ngo5 baa2 fo2
